Ett mellanvärde som räknas fram under et: An intermediate value computed during a forward pass. Changes for every token, unlike weights.
Operation där flera GPU:er summerar sina: An operation where several GPUs sum their partial results so that all of them end up with the same tensor. Used twice per layer with tensor parallelism.
Den del av blocket där varje position hä: The part of the block where each position fetches information from earlier positions, weighted by how well its query matches a key.
Modellen genererar en token i taget, och: The model generates one token at a time, and every new token becomes input to the next step.
Flera sekvenser som bearbetas i samma fo: Several sequences processed in the same forward pass.
Flyttal med 16 bitar. Standardformat för: 16-bit floating point. The standard format for weights in inference: 2 bytes per parameter.
En bit KV-minne för ett fast antal token: A chunk of KV memory for a fixed number of tokens, 16 by default in vLLM.
Lista per sekvens som översätter logiska: A per-sequence list that maps logical blocks to physical blocks in the KV pool.
Byte Pair Encoding. Metod för att bygga: Byte Pair Encoding. A method for building a vocabulary by merging common character pairs.
Regel i attention som gör att position i: A rule in attention that makes position i see only positions 0..i.
Mall som gör om en lista av meddelanden: A template that turns a list of messages into a single string with special tokens.
En lång prompt delas upp över flera steg: A long prompt is split over several steps so that it does not block other requests.
Hastigheten begränsas av GPU:ns räknekra: Speed is limited by the GPU’s compute power. Applies to prefill.
Batchens sammansättning bestäms på nytt: The composition of the batch is decided afresh at every step.
Inspelad kedja av GPU-anrop som spelas u: A recorded chain of GPU calls that is replayed in one go to reduce CPU overhead.
Bredden på residual stream. 4096 i Llama: The width of the residual stream. 4096 in Llama-3-8B.
Fasen där en token i taget genereras med: The phase where tokens are generated one at a time using the KV cache.
Tabell med en vektor per token. Första s: A table with one vector per token. The first step: id → vector.
Transformer med bara en stack, där varje: A transformer with a single stack, where each token sees the tokens before it. The GPT and Llama families are built this way.
Originalets placering av normaliseringen: The original placement of normalization: the stream itself is normalized after every addition.
Arkitektur från 2017 där attention gör h: An architecture from 2017 in which attention does most of the work. The foundation of today’s language models.
En av flera parallella MLP:er i ett MoE-: One of several parallel MLPs in an MoE layer.
Antal flyttalsoperationer. Ungefär 2 per: Number of floating-point operations. Roughly 2 per parameter and token in a forward pass.
Flyttal med 8 bitar. Halverar minnet jäm: 8-bit floating point. Halves memory compared with bf16.
Grouped-Query Attention. Flera query hea: Grouped-Query Attention. Several query heads share one KV head, which shrinks the KV cache.
Sampling som alltid väljer den mest sann: Sampling that always picks the most probable token. Equivalent to temperature 0.
En av flera parallella attention-beräkni: One of several parallel attention computations in a layer. 32 query heads in Llama-3-8B.
Inter-token latency, time per output tok: Inter-token latency, time per output token. The time between two tokens in the response.
Vektor som beskriver vad en position erb: A vector that describes what a position offers. Compared with queries. Stored in the KV cache.
Sparade keys och values för alla tidigar: Saved keys and values for all previous positions, per layer. Lets decode compute only the new position.
Att lagra vikter med färre bitar, till e: Storing weights with fewer bits, for example FP8 or int4.
En omgång attention plus MLP, med 7 vikt: One round of attention plus MLP, with 7 weight matrices and 2 norm weights. Llama-3-8B has 32.
Att skicka residual stream från ett mell: Passing the residual stream from an intermediate layer through the final norm and LM head, to see what the model “thinks” at that point.
Fil (ofta safetensors) som mappar tensor: A file (often safetensors) that maps tensor names to weights, for example model.layers.5.self_attn.q_proj.weight.
En av de 14 336 detektorerna i ett MLP-l: One of the 14,336 detectors in an MLP layer: a column in each of W_gate and W_up, and a row in W_down.
En enskild viktmatris som gör om en vekt: A single weight matrix that transforms a vector, for example q_proj. Called a “linear layer” in PyTorch.
Linjär klassificerare som tränas på akti: A linear classifier trained on activations to see whether a feature is linearly represented.
Sista matrisen, [d, V], som gör om en ve: The last matrix, [d, V], that turns a vector into logits. Also called unembedding.
Ett tal per token i vokabulären, före so: One number per token in the vocabulary, before softmax.
Hastigheten begränsas av hur snabbt data: Speed is limited by how fast data can be read from memory. Applies to decode.
Multi-head Latent Attention. K och V kom: Multi-head Latent Attention. K and V are compressed into a latent vector that is cached.
Den del av blocket som bearbetar varje p: The part of the block that processes each position on its own. Also called feed-forward.
Mixture of Experts. MLP:n ersätts av mån: Mixture of Experts. The MLP is replaced by many experts, and a router picks a few per token.
vLLM:s sätt att lagra KV-cachen i block: vLLM’s way of storing the KV cache in blocks with a block table, similar to virtual memory.
Lagren delas mellan GPU:er: de första på: The layers are split across GPUs: the first ones on one, the later ones on the next.
En request kastas ut ur batchen när KV-m: A request is thrown out of the batch when KV memory runs out and is recomputed later.
Fasen där hela prompten körs genom model: The phase where the whole prompt runs through the model at once and the KV cache is filled.
KV-block för en gemensam början på promp: KV blocks for a shared prompt prefix are reused across requests.
Normalisering före attention och MLP i s: Normalization before attention and the MLP instead of after.
Vektor som beskriver vad en position let: A vector that describes what a position is looking for. Computed and thrown away at every step.
Vektorn per position som löper genom all: The per-position vector that runs through all layers and that every layer adds to.
Normalisering som skalar en vektor så at: Normalization that scales a vector so that its RMS becomes 1.
Rotary Position Embedding. Q och K roter: Rotary Position Embedding. Q and K are rotated depending on position.
Liten linjär matris i ett MoE-lager som: A small linear matrix in an MoE layer that scores each expert.
Storleken på en tensor längs varje axel,: The size of a tensor along each axis, for example [T, 4096].
SiLU är en mjuk variant av ReLU. SwiGLU: SiLU is a smooth variant of ReLU. SwiGLU is the MLP variant where SiLU(gate) is multiplied by up.
Per token: vilken plats i KV-poolen dess: Per token: which slot in the KV pool its K and V should be written to.
Gör om tal till sannolikheter som summer: Turns numbers into probabilities that sum to 1.
Token med särskild roll, till exempel bö: A token with a special role, for example the start of the sequence or the end of a turn.
Ett billigt förslag på flera tokens veri: A cheap guess at several tokens is verified by the large model in a single pass.
Att addera en riktning till residual str: Adding a direction to the residual stream to influence behavior.
Sampling som begränsas av en grammatik s: Sampling constrained by a grammar so that the output always follows a format.
Tal som logits delas med före softmax. L: The number that logits are divided by before softmax. A low value gives a sharper distribution.
Varje viktmatris delas mellan flera GPU:: Every weight matrix is split across several GPUs.
Tokens per sekund summerat över alla req: Tokens per second, summed over all requests.
Textbit med ett id i vokabulären. Ungefä: A piece of text with an id in the vocabulary. Roughly a short word or part of a word.
Klipper bort osannolika tokens före samp: Cuts away unlikely tokens before sampling: the best k, or the smallest set that reaches probability p.
Time to first token. Queue time plus prefill.
Vektor som en position skickar vidare nä: The vector a position passes on when it is picked in attention. Stored in the KV cache.
Inlärt tal i modellen. Fast efter tränin: A learned number in the model. Fixed after training and used for every token.
Mängden av alla tokens. 128 256 i Llama: The set of all tokens. 128,256 in Llama 3.
Head: Head
